title: Flat base change along maps inducing πn-isomorphisms
statement_scope: Whole Proposition 1.5.19: let f: A → B be a morphism of E∞-rings, and suppose that f induces an isomorphism πnA → πnB for all n ≥ 0. Then the pullback functor X ↦ X ×_{Spec A} Spec B induces an equivalence of ∞-categories f*: Stk^♭_B → Stk^♭_A, where Stk^♭_A is the full subcategory of Stk^nc_{/Spec A} spanned by those maps X → Spec A that are flat.

Proposition A.7.2.2.24 on connective covers and flat base change in the affine case.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because the proof at author PDF p. 27 is a concrete base-change equivalence argument: it reduces to the case where f is the inclusion of a connective cover, constructs the right adjoint G(X,O_X)=(X, τ≥0 O_X) and uses Remark 1.5.17 to preserve flatness, then checks the unit and counit transformations are equivalences locally on X and Y and reduces the affine case to Proposition A.7.2.2.24. This is substantial supporting material for the local theory, but not the H3 main comparison theorem.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Reduction to a connective cover, right adjoint by truncating the structure sheaf, and local verification of the unit and counit equivalences with the affine case.
